defects.claim: The PR binds `durationMs`, `docsRead`, `memoriesRead` and `memoriesCreated`, and keys rows on the `subagent` and `context` event types, but nothing in the checkout produces any of them. The only chat producer, `src/lib/api/mockAdapter.ts:2005/2023/2037`, emits just `type: 'progress'`, `'confirmation'` and `'text'`. The diff admits this at `src/lib/api/types.ts:437`: "ASSUMED wire contract — not yet confirmed by the daemon". On a real stack the tree never shows and Context is always `—`.

The PR adds a `mode` key to the `POST /api/v1/chat/messages` body, but nothing in the checkout consumes it. The issue says the pills are "existing chat modes; keep their current semantics", but no such modes exist: a Grep for `mode` in `src/design-system/components/Chat*.vue` finds nothing. The mock ignores the option; `mockAdapter.ts:1994` reads only `if (options?.projectId) conv.projectId = options.projectId`. So the RESEARCH/DOCS pills do nothing.
The issue says "otherwise `—` and list the missing event fields in the PR body". The PR body has no such list, even though the counts are assumed fields with no producer.

There is no test for the new `toChatEvent` fields or the `mode` request body; a case-insensitive Grep for `mode|durationMs|docsRead|subagent` matches only line 1693, which is unrelated. `src/views/__tests__/ChatView.spec.ts` writes fixtures straight into `chat.messages` and stubs `chat.send` with `vi.spyOn(chat, 'send').mockResolvedValue()`, so no test exercises the adapter or event mapping.
The acceptance bullet asks for "one line names the adapter used". No line in the Evidence block names the adapter.
The new `ChatMode` type was inserted between the `ChatSendOptions` docblock ("Optional `sendChatMessage` arguments…") and the interface, so that docblock now sits on `ChatMode`.
Muted text uses the opacity dialect `text-ds-text/60` (also at lines 110, 117, 118, 122 and 123). CLAUDE.md says to prefer the token dialect `text-text-2` / `text-muted`.
The mobile `/chat` tab no longer mounts `ChatWindow`. Confirmation cards (issue drafts, `mockAdapter.ts:2023`) have no renderer on the new page, so mobile users cannot act on them.
